h1: Grand Inter Hotel — the spacious, great-value 3-star business travellers pick in Samut Sakhon
intro: If you have business around Sinsakhon Industrial Estate or central Samut Sakhon and want a hotel with roomy, clean rooms and free parking on a modest budget, Grand Inter Hotel is the name guests here mention most. This 3-star hotel in Khok Kham opened in 2018, has modern rooms — many with balconies — and prices from about ฿700/night. It scores 8.8 from over 450 real guest reviews. The trade-off is a location right by the industrial estate, with little around for an evening stroll.

body.html: The first thing nearly every real review agrees on is that the rooms are spacious and clean. Grand Inter is a 3-star hotel with rooms noticeably bigger than you'd expect at this price. Higher categories like the Family Room and Executive Suite run a generous 52–56 sqm, ideal for groups or families. Every room is modern, with air conditioning, a flat-screen TV, a fridge and a kettle, and many have a private balcony.

The hotel has around 172 rooms, ranging from Deluxe Twin and Deluxe Triple to Family Room and Executive Suite. A point guests praise often is the staff service — reviews describe them as polite, friendly and helpful. Many guests are business travellers or work teams here on errands around the estate, and they note the hotel handles groups easily and stays good value when several people share.
"Very spacious room, clean, comfortable bed, friendly and helpful staff, plenty of parking, breakfast was fine — great value for a hotel in this area."

The facilities that make Grand Inter feel like better value than similarly priced places are free ample parking, a gym and a rooftop view deck. There's an on-site restaurant serving breakfast, room service, a meeting room for seminars, and free Wi-Fi. The rooftop is a spot guests like to head up to in the evening for a breeze and a view over the surrounding area. It's a strong fit for self-drivers, since parking is easy and never a worry.

To be honest, cleanliness isn't perfectly consistent across every room. Most reviews praise it, but a few guests have found a bathroom floor that wasn't spotless, or a musty smell in some rooms. It's not common, and asking staff to change rooms or do an extra clean sorts it out. Breakfast is also fairly simple rather than varied, though the quality is decent — and there are eateries and convenience stores nearby if you want more.

The thing to weigh most is the location. Grand Inter sits in Khok Kham right by Sinsakhon Industrial Estate, which is very convenient if you're working or running errands around the estate, but there isn't much in the way of shops or sights for an evening walk. It's about 15–20 minutes' drive from central Mahachai and CentralPlaza Mahachai, and roughly 45 minutes from Bangkok. If you want nightlife within walking distance or don't have a car, look instead at S9 Hotel or The Eight in central Mahachai.

Overall, Grand Inter Hotel scores 8.8 out of 10 on Trip.com from over 450 real reviews. It's a sensible pick for anyone wanting a spacious, clean 3-star with free parking on a sub-฿1,000 budget — especially those with business around Sinsakhon. Rates start around ฿700 and climb with season and room type to about ฿1,200 for a suite. If you can accept the industrial-estate location and slightly uneven cleanliness, it offers solid value for the price.

faqTitle: Frequently asked questions — Grand Inter Hotel, Samut Sakhon

faq.q: Where is Grand Inter Hotel in Samut Sakhon, and what's nearby?
faq.a: Grand Inter Hotel is at 19/99 Moo 2, Rural Road SKN.5031, Khok Kham, Mueang Samut Sakhon. It's right next to Sinsakhon Industrial Estate (about 5 minutes' drive), around 15–20 minutes from Talad Talay Thai market and central Mahachai, and roughly 45 minutes from Bangkok.

faq.q: How much does Grand Inter Hotel cost, and what room types are there?
faq.a: Rates start at about ฿700/night for a Deluxe Twin. Options range from Deluxe Twin and Deluxe Triple to Family Room and Executive Suite (up to 56 sqm). Prices rise with season and room type to about ฿1,200 — always compare across platforms before booking.

faq.q: Does Grand Inter Hotel have parking and a gym?
faq.a: Yes to both. There's ample free parking, a gym, a rooftop view deck, an on-site restaurant and a meeting room, plus free Wi-Fi in every room. It's well suited to self-drivers and business travellers with errands around the estate.

faq.q: What are the rooms like at Grand Inter Hotel — are they clean?
faq.a: Rooms are larger than the price suggests, modern, and many have balconies. Most reviews praise them as spacious and clean, though a few rooms have had a less-than-spotless bathroom floor or musty smell, which staff can sort with a room change. Every room has air conditioning, a flat-screen TV, a fridge and a kettle.

faq.q: Who is Grand Inter Hotel best for?
faq.a: It's ideal for business travellers, work teams or anyone with errands around Sinsakhon Industrial Estate and central Samut Sakhon who wants a spacious, clean 3-star with free parking on a sub-฿1,000 budget. It's especially good value for groups and families thanks to the larger rooms.

faq.q: What review score does Grand Inter Hotel have?
faq.a: It scores 8.8 out of 10 on Trip.com from over 450 real reviews. Guests consistently praise the spacious, clean rooms, good service and value. The main gripes are the industrial-estate location with nothing to walk to at night, and cleanliness that isn't perfectly consistent room to room.
